name: Gold flight-to-safety divergence — short crypto beta when gold surges on a genuine risk-off while crypto stalls
rationale: MECHANISM: the 2025-26 'Great Decoupling' — gold now behaves as the geopolitical/real-rate shock absorber while crypto behaves as the liquidity sponge (VanEck/JPMorgan). When gold_xau surges on a real risk-off / real-rate flight, capital rotates to the TRUE safe haven and AWAY from speculative beta; crypto's 'digital gold' bid fails and it underperforms. Signal: gold_xau in a strong up-thrust (positive RoC) WHILE crypto momentum stalls/rolls over (negative ret_Nd) tells the flight is real (not a joint liquidity expansion) — fade crypto beta. Counterparty = the 'BTC = digital gold' narrative crowd expecting crypto to rally WITH gold. DISCONFIRMER: gold-crypto correlation is unstable and sometimes POSITIVE (both are debasement/weak-dollar plays). A 'gold up -> crypto down' rule INVERTS exactly when both rally together on debasement. Kill unless OOS shows the divergence fires predominantly during REAL risk-off, not joint debasement rallies. A crypto short also pays funding/borrow — the net-of-fees short edge must clear that carry or it is a mirage.
catalyst: gold up-thrust with crypto momentum stalling (real flight to safety)
